notes: «قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع» and «- واللفظ له -» describe the mode of reading and the wording, not names: left out
«قال قال علي لابن عباس» : Ali's own words are the saying, so Ali is the last link; Ibn Abbas is the addressee, not a link
«عن أبيهما» is the father of the two sons, named by relation only
